text: I wake up at 6:30 every morning, even on weekends. First, I drink a glass of water, then I do ten minutes of stretching before breakfast. My work starts at 9 a.m.; I usually have two meetings and spend the rest of the day on computer tasks. At lunchtime, I go for a thirty-minute walk to get some exercise. In the evening, I cook dinner, read a book or watch a TV show, and I’m in bed by 10:30 p.m. This routine keeps me healthy and productive, so I try to stick to it every day.
